scenario: Agent verifies identity before discussing the account: name, date of birth, SSN, address.
notes: Highest-sensitivity categories outside PCI. Common opening sequence for any account-servicing call.

conversation.text: Before I can pull up the account I'll need to verify a few details with you.
No problem. My name is Robert Alvarez and my date of birth is March 14, 1978.
Thank you. Can you confirm the last four of your social and the service address?
The social is 555-42-8891 and the address is 742 Evergreen Terrace, Seattle, Washington 98101.
That all matches. How can I help you today, Mr. Alvarez?
My internet has been dropping every evening for about a week.
